name: google-mcp
description: Google Search Console, GA4, Google Ads, Business Profile, Merchant Center, PageSpeed Insights, and Tag Manager
long_description: Connect to Google marketing APIs via OAuth2: Search Console for SEO data, GA4 for analytics, Google Ads for campaign management, Business Profile for local performance, Merchant Center for product and issue reporting, PageSpeed Insights for technical audits, and Tag Manager for tag auditing.

google_ads_developer_token.title: Google Ads Developer Token
google_ads_developer_token.description: From Google Ads API Center. Optional unless you use Ads tools.

google_ads_login_customer_id.title: Google Ads MCC Customer ID
google_ads_login_customer_id.description: Manager account customer ID without dashes. Optional.

google_refresh_token.title: Google Refresh Token
google_refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token used to connect to Google APIs.
